_comment: Pinned stories shown above the live Substack feed in #writing. Newest first. Use this for pieces published off the Hinge & The Near Field feed (Medium, The Daily Whatever Show). Remove an entry when it's no longer timely; an empty list hides the block.

stories.title: Anthropic Studied Its Own Workforce, and One Number Should Scare Every New Grad
stories.excerpt: Anthropic’s junior share of new technical hires fell from 27% to 9%, and AI agents now log six hours for every human hour.

stories.title: World War Three Is Here. We’re Still Arguing About the Start Date.
stories.excerpt: Ukraine. Iran. Sabotage in Europe. The next world war may already be underway, and nobody agrees on the start date.

stories.title: The FT Just Noticed World War III. Welcome to the F@#king Party.
stories.excerpt: The FT asked if we’re sleepwalking into World War III. Olga Lautman called it in 2024, Julie Roginsky put it in three headlines, and I said it in my very first post.

stories.title: Trump Wants to Rename New Mexico “New America,” and Holy Sh!t, He’s Serious This Time
stories.excerpt: One rebrand, four miracles, and the state’s name is 223 years older than the country he’s mad at.

stories.title: El-Sayed Disavowed the Muslim Brotherhood on the Spot. Tommy Wouldn’t Disavow Sh!t.
stories.excerpt: A former Josh Hawley staffer demanded that Michigan’s Muslim Senate nominee disavow the Muslim Brotherhood. He did, on the spot. “Tommy” couldn’t disavow putting his own religion into our laws.

stories.title: Facebook Found a Way to Make Homophobia Financially Rewarding
stories.excerpt: At least 29 anti-LGBTQ accounts landed in Meta’s pay-for-engagement program. Apparently, just ruining Thanksgiving was leaving money on the table.
